name: sutando-life-provider
description: Expose bounded, read-only Sutando Life provider capabilities through the local runtime.

inputs: Runtime capability reads for github.activity using identity.get, repositories.list, or repository.events.delta
outputs: Bounded JSON results with stable provider IDs, evidence URLs, cursors, and structured limitations or errors
guarantees: Uses the locally authenticated gh CLI without reading or returning its credential
Per invocation returns at most 100 identities, repositories, or events
